prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1345; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, stiffness, and muscle spasm. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness with restricted cervical and lumbar range of motion, and the reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of this type of crash. Imaging findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to these body areas. Care was delivered over 30 visits and included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and modalities. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no repeated billing observed. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home exercise program.
